prompt.intro: You are shown two screenshots of a browser 3D endless-runner game, labelled Image A and Image B. Both are taken at the same moment of the same run (same road position, same speed), at the same resolution, with the on-screen HUD visible. Exactly one of them is from the original, shipped game; the other is from an independent re-implementation that tries to reproduce it. Judge what is visible: sky, clouds, road, lighting, the runner, effects, the camera and the HUD.
prompt.question: Answer with one JSON object and nothing else, with these keys: "same_game": true if a player would take both for the same game with the same art direction, false otherwise; "same_game_confidence": a number from 0 to 1; "original": "A" or "B", whichever you believe is the original shipped game (you must choose one); "original_confidence": a number from 0.5 to 1; "tells": up to three short phrases naming the visible differences that drove your choice.

note: Original frames are 1280x720 screenshots with HUD; port frames are 1280x720 page screenshots with HUD at the same road distance (idle run at base speed, invulnerable). The original's late frame (hell run) has no port counterpart and is excluded.
